governance.description: Player-prop recommendations are sourced from explicit attributable expert analysis rather than a quantitative prop model. No recommendation may be inferred from generic player praise, fantasy rankings, team-side analysis or an unsupported projection.
governance.recommendationRule: A Recommended prop requires an explicit expert prop direction plus a stated line, threshold, or clearly attributable playable range. Multiple hosts from one show/site count as one correlated source family. Independent-source agreement can increase confidence but is not required when one high-quality expert provides an explicit, well-supported prop recommendation.
governance.priceRule: Do not invent or estimate sportsbook lines or prices. Preserve the expert's cited line/price and separately label any current executable market only when directly observed from a governed source.

confidenceTiers.A: Explicit prop recommendation with detailed football/usage matchup mechanism plus confirmation from at least one independent source family, or unusually strong threshold/price discipline from a high-quality specialist.
confidenceTiers.B: Explicit attributable prop recommendation with a clear mechanism and stated line/threshold from one high-quality source family.
confidenceTiers.Watch: Material player-prop discussion or directional thesis without enough line/price evidence to recommend a wager.

recommendations.matchup: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
recommendations.playTo: Over 55.5 at -110 cited; no broader playable range stated
recommendations.thesis: Green Bay's thinner receiver room should lift Watson's route participation, while Minnesota's heavy two-high and blitz tendencies match splits in which Watson earned targets and produced efficiently in 2025. Josh Jacobs' absence may also increase early pass volume.

recommendations.matchup: New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions
recommendations.playTo: Over 41.5 at -110 cited; no broader playable range stated
recommendations.thesis: New Orleans played at the league's fastest pace in 2025 and became more pass-heavy late. Johnson averaged 57.4 receiving yards in the 10 games in which Tyler Shough played at least 20 snaps, and a large-underdog matchup against Detroit creates a plausible volume path.
recommendations.risk: The Shough sample is limited, and New Orleans' actual Week 1 pace, route share and ability to sustain drives could fall below the late-2025 pattern.
recommendations.independence: Correlated Sharp Football Analysis source family; no independent confirmation used for grade.

recommendations.matchup: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals
recommendations.playTo: Over 23.5 at -111 cited; no broader playable range stated
recommendations.analyst: Josh Shepardson; same-family support from Rich Hribar
recommendations.thesis: Cincinnati's pass-heavy offense draws a Tampa Bay defense that has functioned as a pass funnel and blitzed at a high rate. Brown has earned targets against the blitz, while the Buccaneers allowed league-high receiving production to running backs in 2025.
recommendations.risk: Brown averaged only 23.8 receiving yards in qualifying Joe Burrow games since 2024, leaving little cushion if route participation or checkdown volume disappoints.
recommendations.independence: Shepardson and Hribar are the same Sharp Football Analysis source family and count as one correlated source, not independent confirmation.
